diagnosticWindows.label: v1.0.8-260920
changelog: [feature] OneDrop Diagnose now explains send and nearby failures, not only ANR and jank
[improvement] Hide the HyperOS battery note on Fire tablets and other non-Xiaomi devices
[improvement] Phone Watch shows the OneDrop nearby and transfer panel while watching that app
[bugfix] Unlock Watch now notices a live Desktop grant without tapping Check again
